title: The Ultimate Power Within
award_text: International Impact Book Awards · Body/Mind/Spirit & Personal Growth
lead: A new way to understand, create and use affirmations to advance your dreams, goals and desires. A guidebook and instruction manual for unlocking the power within you.
inside: Resilience & self-empowerment built on daily practice
Goal achievement and personal growth
Shape the world around you by directing the energy your body naturally creates
Align your reality with your deepest desires through thoughts and beliefs
A journey of self-discovery and transformation

quotes.text: “This is a must have book for anyone wishing to bring about the changes in their life to manifest what they want, so that their life is more positive and successful.”
quotes.cite: Susan Grayson, author of Love Your Spiritual Gifts

quotes.text: “Don skillfully articulates the influence of thoughts and beliefs on personal development, making a compelling case for the efficacy of affirmations.”
quotes.cite: Shawna Sellars, author of AstroGod 2024 Planner

title: The Mediums: A Guidebook

inside: Grounding & protection to work safely with energy
The clair senses and how to manage your energy
The mechanics of spirit communication, step by step
Evidential mediumship: one-to-one sittings and platform demonstrations
A professional, ethical practice you can build with confidence
audience: For developing psychics, spiritual healers and practicing evidential mediums who want a powerful, sustainable spiritual practice.

title: A Silence Too Loud
lead: A murdered singer. A haunted hotel. A secret too loud to hide. A gripping paranormal murder mystery of secrets, spirits and the power of truth.
inside: A haunted hotel: the Jerome Grand, in the mountain town of Jerome, Arizona
A murdered singer: Libby Groves, a red-haired singer and nurse who will not stay quiet
A medium’s investigation: cold rooms, flickering lights and visions of her final night
A hidden crime: a corrupted mining empire and the microfilm evidence she died to protect
A town full of secrets and a spirit who refuses to rest until justice speaks

quotes.text: “In Jerome, the dead talk. Don listens. And justice is louder than silence.”

audience: For fans of Midnight Mass, The Haunting of Hill House, Alice Hoffman and atmospheric murder mysteries with a supernatural edge.

subtitle: Whispers at the Jerome Grand
short: A paranormal murder mystery set in haunted Jerome, Arizona: a murdered singer, a haunted hotel, and a secret too loud to hide.
desc: A Silence Too Loud: Whispers at the Jerome Grand by Donald Rumer-Rivera, a paranormal murder mystery set in haunted Jerome, Arizona. Spina & Spiritus, Phoenix AZ.

title: A Space Between Breaths
award_text: No dogma · no perfectionism · no spiritual performance
lead: A grounded, practical path back to presence. Mindfulness as a relationship to restore, drawn from law, engineering, real estate, mediumship and desert-rooted wisdom.
inside: Presence over control: why presence matters more than control
Breath, body and attention: how they create real choice
A gentle 8-week reset that fits real life
Slowing down without falling behind
Living awake without labels or pressure

quotes.text: “You don’t need to escape your life to live it fully.”
quotes.cite: No promises of transformation. No spiritual shortcuts. Just practice.
